title: Mehhhh, cute but a frog is a frog
text: Mehhhh, cute but a frog is a frog. Very flimsy, and when I received it all 4 legs were either bent, or the paint was chipped in some way. Other than that...SO CUTE. Plus you can correct the paint with sharpie colors and just unbend the bent metal...

product_metadata.title: Eangee m412022 Wall Frog Metal Art Piece, Small
features: Produced using sustainable materials and methods and Fair Trade practices
description: Eangee metal art pieces are uniquely styled fair trade, eco-friendly, and sustainable products made in the Philippines, perfect for the bedroom, kitchen, living room, dining room, and kids rooms. The metal is hand painted and adored with capiz, mother of pearl. This piece will fit in almost any location, yet still shows off the beauty of the hand painted design.
